users.view: Open the Candidates and Recruiters lists and their detail pages.
users.deactivate: Suspend recruiters, and reactivate suspended ones.

roles.view: Review roles, admin staff and their effective access.
roles.edit: Change a role’s name, scope, description and permissions.
roles.assign: Assign, change or revoke an admin’s access.

candidates.view: Open the Applications and Recruitment pages.

jobs.view: Open the Jobs list and the job AI summaries.

finance.view: Open Payments, subscription details and revenue.
finance.manage: Edit plan names, features, monthly and yearly prices and the yearly discount.

reports.view: Open Analytics and the report history.
reports.export: Generate reports and download CSV exports.

moderation.manage: Review reports, recruiter accounts and verification evidence.

audit.view: Open the audit log and the Overview’s recent activity.

learning.manage: Build, publish and unpublish courses; revoke certificates.
learning.view: Open the course lists, their statistics and learners.

documents.view: Open KYC, evidence, certificate files and voice notes.

ai.view: Open AI & matching: policies, oversight, feedback and AI status.
ai.manage: Create, edit, activate and archive matching policies.

content.view: Open the blog posts and the newsletter subscriber list.
content.manage: Write, publish, unpublish and delete blog posts.
